entities.summary: Sama Raena Alshaibi  also known as Sama Alshaibi is an Iraqi–Palestinian conceptual artist, who deals with spaces of conflict as her primary subject. War, exile, power and the quest for survival are themes seen in her works. She often uses her own body in her artwork as a representation of the country or an issue she is dealing with.
